LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 4.1.1 PRONUNCIATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Months of the Year Suggested vocabulary later, before, after, sunrise, daylight,
Topic 4.1: Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Months of the Year Suggested vocabulary later, before, after, sunrise, daylight, in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we pronounce words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication: The learner’s ability to listen keenly and actively is enhanced as they listen to teacher/peer model of pronunciation of

words and pronounce the words correctly

• Collaboration: The learner’s ability to work collaboratively with others is enhanced they use new words to make a talking tree.

Values:
Unity: The learner’s ability to work collaboratively with others is enhanced as they sing song /recite rhymes to practise pronunciation.

Link to Pertinent Contemporary Issues:

Life skill (self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they are able to talk about months of the year in various contexts.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Listening attentively and accurate pronunciation are emphasised in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Sample talking tree, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital

devices

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
